questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The '11.11 Home Repairs & Renovation Sale' banner and 'Featured Sellers' / 'Top 11.11 Deals' sections make the campaign obvious.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Deal cards with '-39%' and 'Ends in 17h 59m' draw the eye, but the hero banner has no CTA and the first section is sellers, not deals.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'See all', the seller cards and deal cards all read as taps into what they show.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '5-star reviews', 'active listings', 'Ends in' are familiar terms.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Browsing asks for no decisions beyond picking what looks interesting.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Seller cards stack four stats each ('350+ 5-star reviews', '6 yrs on Carousell', '58 active listings') that could sit on the seller page.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Sellers, timed deals and trending searches all serve a short sale campaign.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Section titles and deal tiles scan easily, but each seller card carries four lines of stats to read before choosing.
